title: Sections and quotients for flasque sheaves
statement: Let 0 \to F \to I \to Q \to 0 be a short exact sequence of abelian sheaves on a topological space X. If F is flasque [def-sc-zariski-flasque], then for every open V the map I(V) \to Q(V) is surjective. If I is also flasque [def-sc-zariski-flasque], then Q is flasque [def-sc-zariski-flasque].
